plan.summary: Changes the status label for stack members that need a rebase. The label text changes from 'needs rebasing' to 'needs to move'. The check `needsRebase(member)` and the 'up to date' label are unchanged.
plan.riskRationale: One string literal changes in a label function. Other code may compare against the old text, which the writer should check.
plan.storyArc: One user-visible label is renamed in statusLabel. The review checks that the new text is used correctly and that no consumer depends on the old text.

topics.title: Rename the rebase status label to 'needs to move'
topics.narrativeBrief: What text does statusLabel return now when a member needs a rebase? Show that the condition is unchanged and only the string differs. Verify that no other code or test compares against 'needs rebasing'.
